{{Quote|Affirmative, AT-ST support is on the way.|An Imperial technician|<ref name="Battlefront" />}}
The '''All Terrain Scout Transport''' ('''AT-ST'''), also known as a '''Scout Transport''', '''Scout Walker''', and also nicknamed a '''chicken walker,''' was a lightweight, bipedal [[walker]] used by the [[Imperial Army|ground forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Later, the [[First Order]] used an [[First Order All Terrain Scout Transport|updated variant]] of the AT-ST within their [[First Order military|military]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|The AT-ST kept spitting lasers at us, and we kept sinking lower and lower into the snow. Each blast took another bite out of the lip of the trench.|[[Chanda Bethari]] describes an AT-ST firing on Hoth|<ref name="Star Wars: On the Front Lines">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''</ref>}}
[[File:ATST-Fathead.png|thumb|left|200px|A partial side view of an AT-ST]]
The All Terrain Scout Transport (abbreviated to AT-ST) was a [[scout]] and reconnaissance light [[walker]]<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[AT-series|All-terrain vehicle]] line.<ref name="Battlefront" /> It consisted of an [[armor]]ed command and control cabin mounted on two [[gyro stabilizer|gyro-stabilized]] legs and was utilized for [[Line of battle|battle line]] support, antipersonnel hunting<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> and troop support. They were also commonly used to screen the flanks of larger assault walkers for major ground operations,<ref name="Visual Guide" /> during which they supported heavier walkers such as [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-ATs]] by eliminating pockets of resistance and clearing out denser terrain such as small [[canyon]]s and [[city|cities]]<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> along the path of a planned invasion route.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref>

The command cabin featured two armored [[viewport]]s which were deliberately set to give any viewer the unsettling sensation of staring into the face of a soulless beast or oversized [[battle droid|combat droid]], despite not actually being needed due to the AT-STs extensive [[sensor]] package.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> Inside the control cabin, the command module featured multiple [[holoprojector]]s<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> which displayed a [[hologram|holographic]] 360-degree view of the combat zone. The cabin (or "head") itself was capable of rotating 240 degrees side to side, greatly benefiting the [[gunner]]'s target-acquisition abilities and capabilities for destruction.<ref name="DS Incredibuilds" /> A cooling system was equipped above the command module behind the entry hatch.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />

===Armament, power, and defense===
AT-STs were equipped with two chin-mounted [[MS-4 twin blaster cannon]]s<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> with a range of two [[kilometer]]s.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> They also featured one cheek-mounted [[88i twin light blaster cannon]] and one cheek-mounted [[DW-3 concussion grenade launcher|DW-3]] [[concussion grenade launcher]] capable of doing massive damage to enemy vehicles and ground troops at close range<ref name="DS Incredibuilds" /> and used at dealing with large amounts of infantry as well as mounted turrets that were too risky to be taken out with rocket launchers.<ref name="Battlefront" /> AT-STs were also equipped with retractable footpad blades<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> which could slash apart wires and fences at ground level.<ref name="DS Incredibuilds" /> The modular design of the All Terrain Scout Transport allowed for ease in customizing the walker with armaments and tools for specific mission parameters, including [[mortar]] launchers that could be attached to the command pod of the AT-ST.<ref name="Legion">{{Legion|set=AT-ST Unit Expansion|cardname=AT-ST Mortar Launcher}}</ref>

[[File:AT-ST_Mortar_Launcher_SWL.png|thumb|left|250px|A mortar launcher attached to the command pod of an AT-ST]]Several areas of the walker's [[hull]] were reinforced with armored plates, including the rear of the command cabin which featured the [[weapon]] [[power converter]]s, the front (or "face"), the joints and the gyro-stabilizing system.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> In addition, reinforced armor plates enveloped the control cabin, protecting the two-person crew from small-arms fire, but not [[laser cannon]]s, [[missile]]s, or other heavy ordnance.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

Due to its small size, the AT-ST could not be equipped with an onboard full [[power generator]], and as such relied on eight disposable high-intensity [[power cell]]s mounted directly at its drive [[engine]]. Two more cells powered the cabin gyro for redundancy. Despite covering the walker's high energy needs, these power cells greatly limited its range.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />

===Locomotion and navigation systems===
The walker's deceptively rickety gait belied a potent patrol vehicle. Gyros and flexible joints formed a complex system that controlled balance and stabilized the walker across a variety of terrains.<ref name="DS Incredibuilds" /> Sophisticated shock-absorbers built inside the lower legs of the walker kept it stable at all times, while a variety of sensors built within its footpads offered detailed feedback on the terrain the AT-ST was moving through, reading intensity and contour for precise foot placement. The locomotion [[computer]] mounted in the command cabin could take control of the walker and use the information relayed from the sensors to drive it [[autopilot|autonomously]] over even ground, although an experienced pilot was still needed over complex terrain.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />

===Performance===
[[File:CoordinatedBombardment-SWQ148.png|left|thumb|250px|The AT-ST was susceptible to laser cannon fire from starfighters.]]
Despite its speed and agility, an AT-ST walker's offensive and defensive power were significantly compromised. Offensively, its weapons systems were only good against lightly armored targets at close range. Defensively, its lighter armor could repel attacks from small-arms fire, but not laser cannons, missiles, or other heavy ordnance.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> Its armor did not cover its entire frame, lest the walker lose its agility. Striking the walker's unprotected gyros underneath the command module could destabilize the walker and cause it to fall. Additionally, deep trenches or cable lines leveled at the height of the AT-ST's ankles and knees could cause it to trip and topple the vehicle.<ref name="DS Incredibuilds" /> AT-STs are also known to require constant maintenance, having perhaps the highest maintenance-per-hour record in the entire [[Imperial Army]].<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

The [[Ewok]]s of [[Endor]] discovered that the AT-STs were vulnerable to anti-[[Gorax]] traps. Ramming logs could smash through the walker's head, destroying the cockpit. One of its other weaknesses was its susceptibility to hijacking, despite the height of the vehicle seemingly making hijacking an impossibility. A sufficiently strong force could rip the entrance hatch off the top of the walker. If commandeered, the walker's cannons could easily penetrate other AT-STs' armor.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /><ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

==Variant models==
[[File:At-st-driver-51eb6a3.png|thumb|180px|right|An AT-ST pilot]]

===All Terrain Construction Transport===
{{Main|All Terrain Construction Transport}}
The [[All Terrain Construction Transport]] saw use for construction proposes.<ref name="Walkers and Ground">{{EncyclopediaCite|Walkers and Ground Vehicles of the Empire and First Order}}</ref>

===All Terrain Exploration Transport===
{{Main|All Terrain Exploration Transport}}
Also known as the "Strider," the [[All Terrain Exploration Transport]] was itself a smaller version of the [[AT-EST Exploration and Survey Walker]].<ref name="Savage Spirits">''[[Savage Spirits]]''</ref>

===AT-KT===
{{Main|AT-KT}}
The [[AT-KT]] was nicknamed the "Hunter" and saw use on the planet [[Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Walkers and Ground" />

===All Terrain Scout Transport/Assault===
{{Main|All Terrain Scout Transport/Assault}}
The [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Assault]] was a direct assault variant of the AT-ST.<ref name="Walkers and Ground" />

===AT-ST Mark III===
{{Main|AT-ST Mark III}}
The AT-ST Mark IIIs were equipped with experimental [[armor]] that provided more speed and durability than that of the standard AT-ST. Mounted with twin [[heavy laser cannon]]s and piloted by veteran crews, they excelled against most targets.<ref name="Commander" />
[[File:ATSTraider-AG.png|thumb|150px|right|An AT-ST Raider]]

===AT-ST Raider===
{{Main|AT-ST Raider}}
A variant used by a [[Klatooinian]] [[Klatooinian raiders|tribe]].<ref name="Chapter 4">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 4: Sanctuary}}</ref>

===Enhanced AT-ST Walker===
{{Main|Enhanced AT-ST Walker}}
The enhanced AT-ST Walkers boasted enhanced power couplings and sub-systems, allowing their weapons to fire high-powered blasts at a faster rate than average. They also had [[Color|dark]] armor plates.<ref name="Commander" />

===First Order AT-ST===
[[File:FirstOrderATST-TGTB.png|thumb|right|150px|The AT-ST variant fielded by the First Order.]]
{{Main|First Order All Terrain Scout Transport}}
The First Order utilized an updated version of the AT-ST that featured upgraded armor and gyroscopic systems.<ref name="The Last Jedi">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> Several of them were stored aboard the ''[[Supremacy]]''.

===All Terrain Heavy Scout===
{{Main|All Terrain Heavy Scout}}
The All Terrain Heavy Scout was a highly evolved variant of the First Order AT-ST, which saw service in the [[First Order Army]] during the intergalactic [[First Order-Resistance War]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I've seen that thing take out entire companies of soldiers in a matter of minutes.|Cara Dune, on the AT-ST|<ref name="Chapter 4">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 4: Sanctuary}}</ref>}}
[[File:EvasiveManeuvers-SWQ156.png|thumb|left|250px|AT-STs took part in defeating the Rebel Alliance at the Battle of Hoth.]]
Part of the All-Terrain walker family, the AT-ST was better equipped than the Republic [[All Terrain Reconnaissance Transport|AT-RT]]<ref name="DS Incredibuilds" /> and was in service by the [[Invasion of Mon Cala]] in [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Darth Vader (2017) 14">[[Darth Vader (2017) 14|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 14]]</ref> The toes for the walker's feet were manufactured by convicts in the [[Jubilar]] [[Prison|penal work camp]].<ref name="Rise">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref>

In [[14 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' to [[14 BBY]].</ref> an AT-ST attacked the ''[[Stinger Mantis]]'' ship on [[Zeffo]], but was destroyed by the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Cal Kestis]]. The Empire used AT-STs against the [[Partisans]] led by [[Saw Gerrera]] on [[Kashyyyk]] and Kestis, who helped the rebel group during the battle to take over an imperial refinery. The AT-STs were on [[Ilum]] when the Empire started mining the world to acquire Kyber crystals. When Kestis went to the planet to find a crystal to build a new lightsaber, two AT-STs were destroyed by the Padawan during his escape from the world.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''</ref>

[[File:ATST-SWL2024update.png|thumb|270px|right|A AT-ST enters a heavily damaged Rebel base.]]
The [[Imperial Military]] commonly used the AT-ST in a variety of environments.<ref name="RougeOne">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> After rebel leader [[Saw Gerrera]] and his [[Partisans]] took to defending the world of [[Jedha]], AT-STs were among the reinforcements deployed to aid the planet's occupying [[garrison]]; with the ancient [[Jedha City|Holy City]] consumed by [[Ground warfare|surface warfare]], the AT-STs were fielded for urban pacification<ref name="Walkers and Ground Vehicles">{{EncyclopediaCite|Walkers and Ground Vehicles of the Empire and First Order}}</ref> against the Partisans<ref name="RougeOne" /> whenever they could fit into the city's winding and narrow streets. While accordingly impractical during the [[Jedha insurgency]], the walkers were also fielded to try to send a message beyond their blaster fire, but the Partisans instead chose to intensify their efforts against the garrison. With the Empire retaliating in equal force, battle continued in the streets, with AT-STs devastating the city and civilians. Even so, both sides continued to fight,<ref name="Walkers and Ground Vehicles" /> with one AT-ST being deployed in [[Tythoni Square]] as part of the [[battle on Jedha]]<ref name="RougeOne" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Date Note 1 BBY">The [[battle on Jedha]] took place during ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[1 BBY]].</ref> The insurgency ended when all but at least three percent of the Imperial garrison retreated under [[Protocol 13]]. Afterward, the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]] [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] the Holy City.<ref name="Rogue One novel">[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]]</ref>

[[File:LogTraps-SWL110.png|thumb|270px|left|An AT-ST succumbs to an Ewok log trap during the Battle of Endor]]
The walkers were also used in the [[Galactic Civil War]]. At least one fought in the [[Battle of Allst Prime]].<ref name="IB">{{InsiderCite|161|Inbrief}}</ref> General [[Vitsun Weiss|Weiss]] commanded a customized AT-ST.<ref name="Weiss">{{Legion|set=AT-ST Unit Expansion|cardname=General Weiss}}</ref> Between the [[Battle of Yavin]] and Battle of Hoth, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operated stolen AT-STs, and provided them to [[Tatooine rebel cell|Saponza's Gang]], who often fought against the walkers.<ref name="Commander" /> Three AT-STs were deployed as part of [[Lieutenant-Inspector]] [[Magna Tolvan]]'s [[Second attack on the Son-tuul Pride|attack]] on the [[Son-tuul Pride]] crime syndicate.<ref name="Aphra 19">[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 19|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 19]]</ref> Several fought alongside [[All Terrain Armored Transport]]s (AT-ATs) at the [[Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Empire Strikes Back">{{Film|V}}</ref> They also notably participated in the [[Battle of Endor]], where they were defeated by the Ewoks and their<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> anti-[[Gorax]]<ref name="AEYNtK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> traps. One walker,<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> [[Tempest Scout 2]],<ref name="Preview Tempest Force">{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/scene-to-stat-tempest-force-battle-force|text=Scene to Stat: Tempest Force Battle Force}}</ref> was captured by the rebel [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] and two Ewoks, [[Widdle Warrick]] and [[Wunka]].<ref name="ROTJ Beware">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref>

[[File:AT-ST-closes-in.png|thumb|right|270px|Like the rest of the Imperial Army, AT-STs fought rebellious forces, including the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.]]
AT-STs were constructed in a [[Abandoned weapons depot|weapons depot]] the Empire kept in operation on the world of [[Sullust]], which was able to remain in operation despite the [[Liberation of Sullust|planet's liberation]]. [[Destruction of an abandoned weapons depot|Infiltrating and destroying the factory]], [[New Republic]] General [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian]] and soldier [[Shriv Suurgav]] escaped aboard an AT-ST. The factory's destruction robbed the Empire of additional equipment it was awaiting on the planet [[Jakku]].<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront 2" /> Nonetheless, a number of AT-STs the Empire still had its disposal were used in the ensuing final battle of the Galactic Civil War, the [[Battle of Jakku]], which ended up being an overwhelming victory for the New Republic.<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY Date">{{MandoDate}}</ref> an AT-ST was used by looters to attack a [[Unidentified village (Sorgan)|village]] on the planet [[Sorgan]]. The AT-ST became embroiled in the [[Skirmish on Sorgan|battle]] between the looters and the village people, who were suddenly led by [[Mandalorian]] bounty hunter [[Din Djarin]] and former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[shock trooper]] [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]]. In the end, Djarin destroyed the walker with a [[grav charge]].<ref name="Chapter 4" />

Thirty years after the close of the Galactic Civil War, a splinter military group of the New Republic called the [[Resistance]] utilized old Imperial AT-STs in combat against the reorganized remnants of the Galactic Empire, the [[First Order]]. They possessed an orange repaint and were crested with the [[Rebel Alliance starbird|Resistance starbird]].<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
All Terrain Scout Transports first appeared in the [[1980]] motion picture [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="Empire Strikes Back" /> The AT-ST model received some cosmetic changes for its extensive appearance in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], thus explaining the minor differences in the models used for the two films.<ref name="ATSTitDB">{{DB|vehicle|atst|All Terrain Scout Transport (AT-ST walker)}}</ref>
